<a id="why"></a>

## Why

The operator comes back to a fleet that ran overnight and has to read many cards and logs to learn what happened. One short digest a day would answer that.

| req-02 | Decisions first | The digest opens with anything waiting on the operator, before the activity list. | prime | should | [ ] planned | A digest written while a question is open shows that question in its first section. | — | — | — |
| req-03 | No cost when idle | Writing the digest launches nothing when the fleet did nothing that day. | operator | must | [ ] planned | A day with no activity writes a one-line digest and the spawn counter does not move. | — | — | — |
